scenicChapters.title: Paso de Jama
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Paso de Jama, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Salar de Talar → Paso Sico
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

atacama-altiplano-route.story: A one-way ride of 366 km, San Pedro de Atacama to the finish - roughly 5 h 02 in the saddle. The stops in between: Valle de la Luna, Lagunas Miscanti and Miniques and Salar de Talar. The highest point is about 4,600 m. It crosses from Chile into Argentina - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
